en_title: Sony Battling Spider-Man: Brand New Day Post-Credit Scene Leaks, Scrubbing Social Media Via Copyright Claims
cn_title: 索尼打击《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》彩蛋泄露
subtitle: 剧透警报
opus_summary: 索尼正以版权声明清理网上流传的《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》片尾彩蛋片段，该片7月31日上映。IGN提醒想避开剧透的观众在观影前远离社交媒体、Reddit和评论区。

paragraphs.en: Sony is battling a major Spider-Man: Brand New Day leak, and using copyright claims to scrub the movie's post-credits scene from social media.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼正在应对《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的一次重大泄露，并通过版权声明清理社交媒体上的电影片尾彩蛋。

paragraphs.en: Footage of the film's post-credits scene, seemingly recorded from within a theater, began circulating on X early this morning. IGN has now seen multiple copies of this footage removed from the platform via copyright claims — something that only proves it legitimacy further.
paragraphs.cn: 这段片尾彩蛋画面看来是在影院内录下的，今天清晨开始在X上传播。IGN现已看到多个副本因版权声明被从该平台移除，这反而进一步证明了其真实性。

paragraphs.en: Officially, Spider-Man: Brand New Day does not release until July 31, though the movie has now had its official premiere on July 27, and early previews begin within a matter of hours the same day. It's unclear where footage of the post-credits scene originated, though some theaters clearly now have access to the film.
paragraphs.cn: 按官方安排，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》要到7月31日才上映；不过影片已于7月27日举行正式首映礼，提前场也将在当天数小时内开启。目前尚不清楚片尾彩蛋画面从何而来，但显然已有一些影院拿到了这部电影。

paragraphs.en: While Sony is removing some instances of the footage, IGN has seen other versions that are still being hosted on social media at the time of writing — and it is unrealistic to think that Sony's legal team will likely catch every one.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管索尼正在移除部分片段，IGN在截稿时仍看到其他版本留在社交媒体上；认为索尼的法务团队能找到并删除每一个版本并不现实。

paragraphs.en: For anyone hoping to go into Spider-Man: Brand New Day blind, take this as your warning to now avoid social media, reddit and internet comments threads until you have seen the movie, or risk major plot elements from the film being spoiled.
paragraphs.cn: 若你希望毫无预设地观看《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》，请把这当作警告：在看完电影前避开社交媒体、Reddit和互联网评论区，否则影片的重要剧情元素可能会被剧透。

paragraphs.en: While you wait for the movie's official launch, Insomniac Games' great Spider-Man 2 now has Tom Holland's Brand New Day costume to swing around in. And you can read through our past coverage surrounding the mystery of who Sadie Sink is playing, as teased by Deadpool actor Ryan Reynolds , seemingly denied by Tom Holland , and even in footage from the movie that fans still can't decipher .
paragraphs.cn: 在等待影片正式上映期间，你现在可以在Insomniac的优秀作品《蜘蛛侠2》中穿上汤姆·霍兰德的《崭新之日》战衣荡蛛丝。你还可以阅读我们此前关于Sadie Sink饰演谁这一谜团的报道：这件事似乎曾被《死侍》演员瑞安·雷诺兹暗示过，又似乎遭汤姆·霍兰德否认，连影迷至今仍无法解读的电影片段也牵涉其中。

paragraphs.en: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day sees Destin Daniel Cretton effectively refocus on the sturdiest pillars of the webslinger: struggling to find balance while swinging around New York City saving the day, and looking dang cool doing it," we wrote in IGN's Spider-Man: Brand New Day review . "There’s more than a little déjà vu going on with a lot of Peter’s inner turmoil, and that does sometimes leaving the 'brand new day' of the title feeling like Groundhog Day, but overall, it’s a refreshingly small-scale ride."
paragraphs.cn: 我们在IGN的《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》评测中写道：「《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》让Destin Daniel Cretton有效地将重心重新放回这位吐丝英雄最稳固的支柱：一边在纽约市上空荡来荡去拯救世界，一边努力寻找平衡，同时还帅气十足。彼得的许多内心挣扎都颇有似曾相识之感，这有时会让片名中的‘崭新之日’反而像《土拨鼠之日》；但总体而言，这是一段令人耳目一新的小规模冒险。」
